method: Frozen universe and pre-registration (backtest_universe.json); two_sources decided by independent blind Claude judges on every window clearing the proxy and conditions 3-5 (backtest_calibration_result.json, plan 6c).
disclosures: 38 symbols have no Alpha Vantage earnings history (mostly delisted/acquired) and 3 tickers were invalid: a survivorship gap in the data source.
News archive density rises steeply toward 2026, so 2025-2026 dominate the judged sample (380 of 498 book trades).
The surfaced stratum (+0.97% mean excess, n=136) was chosen by the live system in 2026 and is hindsight-exposed; the survivorship-free sampled stratum is -0.56% (n=362).
An evidence line from the invalid v1 proxy was printed once before judging (see backtest_calibration_result.json).
Not modelled: sector caps, cash floor beyond settled cash, slippage past stops beyond the 0.10% cost.
